detailed:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one polished 16:9 direct in-game screenshot concept for FALL, a medieval card game. Match the established Card Hall style: painterly cool slate-blue medieval stone, tall leaded windows to the left, warm oak table and restrained antique brass, Cinzel-like strong Roman uppercase heading and clear Spline Sans-like functional type. Behind the modal is the same recognizable dimmed Card Hall hub with three portrait activity cards (tavern, hilltop campaign, arena), subdued so only the modal reads. The modal is for a tiny real settings set, with simple left aligned grouped rows, generous touch sizes and clean contrast. Exact modal text: "Settings", "Preferences", "Appearance", "Light", "Dark", "System", "Help", "How to play", "Sings reference", "About", "Credits & licenses", "Done". Selected Dark uses solid muted warm fill plus a distinct selected marker. Show close X at top right and compact outline icons on the link rows. Links have right chevrons. No other modal text, no placeholder rows, no tabs, no save button, no invented functionality. Artwork is decorative, isolated from controls, no legibility problems.
Detailed edition: a wide, centered premium modal at roughly 64% of viewport width and 76% of height. A decorative left third is a separate framed illustration of two Spanish-suited cards and a brass lantern on a warm oak table, with a cool stone window behind. Right two thirds contain all controls over a solid near-black charcoal panel with subtle warm trim. Fine restrained corner engravings and carefully spaced separators. Done in the lower right.
